run_adaptive_varnet_training: run the adaptive VarNet training pipeline on fastMRI knee data with configurable acquisition learning
build_argument_parser: build the argument parser with defaults for data path, mask type, cascades, and WandB logging
create_wandb_logger_callback: create a WandB callback that logs train and validation metrics including SSIM, PSNR, and NMSE per epoch
test_varnet_model: test a trained VarNet or AdaptiveVarNet model on the fastMRI test split using PyTorch Lightning
make_wandb_run_name: make a descriptive WandB run name from acquisition type, acceleration rate, cascades, and hyperparameters
